ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-01-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name for an adult and a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Hai Xum Yu, present in pro per, and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Antony Yu, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Hai Xun Yu, and the Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Anthony Yu.
Decree signed in open court.
